Questions, answered

Let's Make Things Easy For You

Everything you need before, during and after your order. If you still need a hand, our care team is ready.

Most pieces run from XXS to XXL. Each product page includes garment measurements and a fit note so you can compare them with something you already own.

Yes. We ship to more than 40 countries. Delivery windows and any local duties are shown at checkout before you place your order.

Once your parcel leaves our studio, we send a tracking link by email. It updates as the parcel moves through the carrier network.

We prioritize recycled and certified fibers, small production runs and durable construction. Material details are listed clearly on every product page.

Unworn items with original tags can be returned within 30 days. Exchanges are free where available; otherwise, we issue a refund and help you reorder.
